name: Element has Element_ID
description: Ensure that every BIM element exported to IFC includes a non‑empty Element_ID parameter. A missing or misspelled property is a common pitfall when embedding IFC‑SG parameters, leading to incomplete mapping or incorrect validation【431666132276182†L23-L29】.
message: Element_ID is missing or empty. Add a unique identifier for this element.

name: Check Property Name Spelling
description: Many IFC‑SG properties are manually created in BIM authoring tools. Misspellings will cause them to be omitted from the exported IFC file【431666132276182†L23-L29】. This rule verifies that property names exactly match the IFC‑SG mapping file.
message: Property name does not match the IFC‑SG specification. Check spelling against the mapping file.

name: Property Set Assignment
description: Properties must belong to the correct property set. For example, FireRating should be part of Pset_WallCommon rather than SGPset_Wall according to the IFC‑SG mapping【431666132276182†L23-L29】.
message: FireRating assigned to an incorrect property set. Move it to Pset_WallCommon.

name: Mandatory IFC‑SG Parameter Presence
description: Checks that agency‑specific mandatory parameters from the IFC‑SG mapping file are present. For example, mechanical ventilation systems need air change rates and supply/exhaust configurations as part of NEA requirements【632392668205234†L35-L39】.
message: AirChangeRate is required for spaces subject to mechanical ventilation. Provide a numeric value.

name: Numeric Parameter Validation
description: Validates that numeric parameters such as Length, Breadth and Height are positive numbers and reflect the actual element geometry. Incorrect values can lead to wrong dimensioning in regulatory submissions【431666132276182†L42-L49】.
message: Dimension parameter must be a positive number. Check Length, Breadth and Height values.

name: Presence of MP_Category
description: The Model Purpose category (MP_Category) identifies the discipline and regulatory gateway for each element. Missing MP_Category reduces the usefulness of the IFC‑SG model and leads to incorrect validation results【431666132276182†L42-L49】.
message: MP_Category is missing. Set the correct model purpose category based on the IFC‑SG specification.

name: Ventilation Equipment Agency Parameters
description: For NEA submissions, ventilation equipment must include pollution control and sanitary provisions. This rule ensures required parameters such as GreaseTrapSize and OdorControlSystem are present【632392668205234†L35-L38】.
message: NEA parameters missing on ventilation equipment. Add GreaseTrapSize and OdorControlSystem details.
